01. Unit, integration, system and end-to-
end tests

Unit tests check small behavior; integration tests check component interactions; system tests
check the integrated product; E2E tests exercise a realistic complete journey.
Unit test එJකන් කුඩා function එකක් බලනවා. Integration test එJකන් Jකාටස් එකට වැඩ

Q: What is the difference between unit and integration tests?
A: Unit isolates a small behavior; integration verifies real collaborators interact.
